_note: DEMO DATA. Officina Lume, Verdi Logistics, NordPrint and every person here are fictional. No real client or personal data.
company: Officina Lume (fictional 20-person digital product studio, Turin)

sources.title: Atlas project charter
sources.body: Client: Verdi Logistics. Project Atlas is a route-planning web app. Public launch: 15 December 2026. Delivery lead: Marco Bellini. Account and billing owner: Giulia Rinaldi.

sources.title: Atlas contract summary
sources.body: Fixed fee EUR 84,000 excluding VAT, invoiced in three milestones of EUR 28,000. Milestone 1 on kickoff (paid 12 Oct). Milestone 2 on the client's written sign-off of staging. Milestone 3 on public launch. Client payment terms: 30 days.

sources.title: Supplier register
sources.body: NordPrint S.r.l. (print and packaging), contact orders@nordprint.example. Payment terms: 30 days from invoice date, per framework agreement signed 3 March 2026. Any change to terms requires a signed amendment.

sources.title: Atlas runbook
sources.body: Staging runs on Cloud Run in europe-west1, service atlas-staging. Deploy freeze from 12 December until launch. Staging API keys are rotated before every freeze.

sources.title: Q4 cloud budget
sources.body: Cloud budget for Q4 is EUR 2,400 per month. Alert threshold at 80% (EUR 1,920). Any overrun must be approved by Giulia Rinaldi.

sources.title: Office handbook
sources.body: The office is closed from 24 December to 6 January. Expense claims must be filed within 30 days.

sources.title: #atlas · Luca (designer)
sources.body: heard from someone at the coffee machine that Atlas launch might slip to end of January?? not confirmed lol

sources.title: #verdi-billing · Elena Conti (Verdi Logistics)
sources.body: Heads-up from our side: from now on please send all Atlas invoices to ap@verdi-logistics.example, not to me directly.

sources.title: #eng · Marco
sources.body: SSO login on staging is broken in Safari, I'm on it.

sources.title: Task: rotate staging API keys before freeze
sources.body: Assignee: Marco Bellini. Due 11 December 2026. Status: open.

sources.body: Assignee: Giulia Rinaldi. Due on client sign-off of staging. Status: open.

sources.title: Atlas staging — sign-off
sources.body: Hi both, we tested staging over the weekend and it looks good. Please take this email as our formal written sign-off of staging. Elena Conti, Verdi Logistics

sources.title: Billing alert: 85% of monthly budget
sources.body: December month-to-date cloud spend is EUR 2,050, which is 85% of your EUR 2,400 monthly budget.
